findings.text: 28-day lead_drought confirmed: $591.94 Google Ads spend, 124 clicks, 0 leads, 0 GA4 conversions — conversion tracking or form/call path is broken.
SOW overdue: Stripe Products QA milestone marked Done 2026-07-20 but GHL shows 0 won opportunities and $0 value across 133 opps created — money path unverified.
3-day spend signal (Aug 25–27: $19.58, $13.98, $19.69) is stable but 3-day leads (0, 0, 0) vs prior 3 (0, 0, 0) — drought is not improving; not a bad week, it is structural.
GBP actions spiked 140% (38 total, 37 direction requests) but GBP calls = 0 and GA4 conversions = 0 — local intent rising but no call or web conversion path captures it.
GHL pipeline shows 133 opportunities created, 0 won, $0 value — either intake is routing opps with no follow-through, or opp creation is automated noise with no real lead behind it.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and call-tracking setup — zero leads from $592 spend confirms broken path, not audience miss.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $591.94 over 28 days across 124 clicks with zero recorded leads or conversions — this is a structural tracking or destination failure, not a bidding problem. Verify: (1) conversion action is firing on the thank-you page or call-end event, (2) the call extension number routes correctly, (3) the landing page form submits without error. Success check: at least 1 confirmed conversion event visible in Google Ads within 72 hours of the fix. Deadline: 2026-08-31.
